units.locator: Article 20.11. Failure to meet deadlines for registration (re-registration) of weapons or for entering them in the records
units.text: 1. Failure by a citizen to meet the established deadlines for registering weapons acquired under licences issued by the federal executive body performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation or its territorial body, the established deadlines for renewing (re-registering) permits (open licences) to store and carry such weapons, or the deadlines for entering weapons in the records of that federal executive body or its territorial body when the citizen changes their permanent place of residence —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.11

units.locator: Article 20.11. Failure to meet deadlines for registration (re-registration) of weapons or for entering them in the records
units.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of one thousand to three thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.11 · “shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of one…”

units.locator: Article 20.11. Failure to meet deadlines for registration (re-registration) of weapons or for entering them in the records
units.text: 2. Failure by officials responsible for the storage and use of weapons to meet the deadlines for entering weapons in the records of the federal executive body performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation or its territorial body, or for renewing (re-registering) permits (open licences) to store and carry them —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.11

units.locator: Article 20.11. Failure to meet deadlines for registration (re-registration) of weapons or for entering them in the records
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to five thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.11 · “shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to five…”

units.text: 1. Dispatch of weapons, if these acts do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.12

units.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the weapons.

units.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition
units.text: 2. Violation of rules for the carriage or transportation of weapons and ammunition, except in the cases provided for by part 4 of this Article —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.12

units.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.12 · “shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to one…”

units.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition
units.text: 3. Violation of rules for the use of weapons and ammunition —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.12

units.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to three thousand roubles or deprivation of the right to acquire and store, or to store and carry, weapons for one to two years.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.12 · “shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five…”

units.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition
units.text: 4. Violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons resulting in their loss, if these acts do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 20.12

units.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the weapons, or deprivation of the right to acquire and store, or to store and carry, weapons for one to three years with or without confiscation of the weapons; for officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the weapons, or disqualification for six months to three years with or without confiscation of the weapons; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the weapons, or administrative suspension of their activities for up to sixty days.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 20.12 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five…”

units.text: 1. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules —

units.locator: Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the weapons and ammunition.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.13 · “shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five…”

units.locator: Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose

units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.13

units.locator: Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles with confiscation of the weapons and ammunition, or deprivation of the right to acquire and store, or to store and carry, weapons for one and a half to three years with confiscation of the weapons and ammunition.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.13 · “shall entail an administrative fine of forty thousand to fifty…”

units.locator: Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose
units.text: 3. The act provided for by part 2 of this Article committed by a group of persons or by a person who is intoxicated —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.13

units.locator: Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles with confiscation of the weapons and ammunition, or deprivation of the right to acquire and store, or to store and carry, weapons for three years with confiscation of the weapons and ammunition.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.13 · “shall entail an administrative fine of fifty thousand to one…”

units.locator: Article 20.15. Sale without the appropriate licence of mechanical sprayers, aerosol and other devices loaded with tear-inducing or irritant substances, electric shock devices or spark dischargers

units.label: Art. 20.15 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two…”

units.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities
units.text: 1. Carrying on private security activities without a special permit (licence), or providing security services by a person who does not have the legal status of a private security guard —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.16

units.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand five hundred to five thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to sixty thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.16 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two…”

units.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities
units.text: 1.1. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article —
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 20.16

units.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles or compulsory work for one hundred to two hundred hours; for officials, disqualification for six months to three years; for legal entities, sixty-five thousand to one hundred thirty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 20.16 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five…”

units.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities
units.text: 2. Carrying on private detective (investigative) activities without a special permit (licence) —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.16

units.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.16 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two…”

units.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities
units.text: 3. Providing vocational training and additional professional education for personnel engaged in private detective or security activities without a special permit (licence) or in violation of statutory requirements —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.16

units.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for the head of the institution of four thousand to five thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.16 · “shall entail an administrative fine for the head of the…”

units.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities
units.text: 4. Providing private detective or security services not provided for by law, or providing such services in violation of statutory requirements —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 20.16

units.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for private detectives (security guards) of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles; for heads of private security organizations, three thousand to five thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 20.16 · “shall entail an administrative fine for private detectives…”

units.locator: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility
units.text: 1. Unauthorized entry into a facility guarded in the established manner, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 and 3 of this Article —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.17

units.locator: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence, or compulsory work for up to forty hours with or without confiscation of that instrument, or administrative arrest for up to five days with or without confiscation of that instrument.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.17 · “shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five…”

units.locator: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility
units.text: 2. Unauthorized entry into a facility guarded in the established manner belonging to the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, the federal executive body authorized to perform tasks in civil defence and protection of the population and territories against natural and technological emergencies, the Foreign Intelligence Service of the Russian Federation, the bodies of the Federal Security Service, the system of the federal executive body responsible for internal affairs, or institutions and bodies of the penal enforcement system of the Russian Federation, or into facilities under the jurisdiction of the federal executive body responsible for mobilization preparation and mobilization —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.17

units.locator: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence, or compulsory work for forty to sixty hours with or without confiscation of that instrument, or administrative arrest for up to ten days with or without confiscation of that instrument.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.17 · “shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to ten…”

units.locator: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility
units.text: 3. Unauthorized entry into a facility of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation guarded in the established manner, a guarded facility protected by state protection bodies, an underground or underwater facility guarded in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on departmental security, a fuel and energy complex facility assigned a hazard category, or an important state facility or a structure on communications routes or networks, or access to special cargo, where that facility, structure or cargo is guarded by the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, if this act does not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.17

units.locator: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of seventy-five thousand to two hundred thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence, or compulsory work for sixty to one hundred twenty hours with or without confiscation of that instrument, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days with or without confiscation of that instrument.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.17 · “shall entail an administrative fine of seventy-five thousand to…”
